intro: Deathstalker Faerleia is an operative of the Forsaken intelligence agency stationed deep within enemy territory inside Pyrewood Village. Operating out of the settlement's town hall, she orchestrates covert strikes against the local Gilnean leadership.

p: As an agent of the Deathstalkers—the covert intelligence and assassin branch of the Undercity—Faerleia is tasked with infiltrating Pyrewood Village in southern Silverpine Forest. The isolated human enclave harbors dark secrets, including a curse that transforms its populace under the night sky. Stationed within the upper levels of the town hall, Faerleia coordinates operations to disrupt the settlement from the inside, calling on Horde operatives to eliminate the influential members of the Pyrewood Council.
